integrations.name: Firecrawl

integrations.longDescription: Integrate Firecrawl into the workflow. Scrape pages, search the web, crawl entire sites, map URL structures, and extract structured data with AI.

operations.description: Search for information on the web using Firecrawl

operations.name: Crawl
operations.description: Crawl entire websites and extract structured content from all accessible pages

operations.name: Crawl Status
operations.description: Check the status and retrieve results of a previously started Firecrawl crawl job by its job ID.

operations.name: Cancel Crawl

operations.name: Extract Status
operations.description: Check the status and retrieve results of a previously started Firecrawl extract job by its job ID.

operations.name: Agent

integrations.name: Google Docs
integrations.description: Read, write, create, and edit documents
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Google Docs into the workflow. Read, write, and create documents, insert text, tables, images, and page breaks, find and replace text, and apply text styling.

operations.name: Read Document
operations.description: Read content from a Google Docs document

operations.name: Write to Document
operations.description: Append content to a Google Docs document. Content is inserted literally; Markdown is not interpreted. For formatted output from Markdown, use the Create operation with the markdown toggle enabled.

operations.name: Create Document
operations.description: Create a new Google Docs document

operations.name: Insert Text
operations.description: Insert text at a specific index in a Google Docs document. When no index is provided, text is appended to the end of the document. Text is inserted literally; Markdown is not interpreted.

operations.name: Find & Replace Text
operations.description: Replace all occurrences of a search string with new text across a Google Docs document.

operations.name: Insert Table
operations.description: Insert an empty table with the given number of rows and columns into a Google Docs document. When no index is provided, the table is appended to the end of the document.

operations.name: Insert Image
operations.description: Insert an inline image from a public URL into a Google Docs document. The image must be publicly accessible and under 50 MB. When no index is provided, the image is appended to the end of the document.

operations.name: Insert Page Break
operations.description: Insert a page break into a Google Docs document. When no index is provided, the page break is appended to the end of the document.

operations.name: Apply Text Style
operations.description: Apply bold, italic, underline, and/or font size to a range of text in a Google Docs document, identified by its start and end character index.

operations.name: Apply Paragraph Style
operations.description: Apply a named paragraph style (such as a heading or title) and/or alignment to the paragraphs overlapping a range of text in a Google Docs document, identified by its start and end character index.

operations.name: Create Bullets
operations.description: Add bulleted or numbered list formatting to the paragraphs overlapping a range of text in a Google Docs document, using a chosen bullet glyph preset.

operations.name: Delete Bullets
operations.description: Remove bullet or numbered list formatting from the paragraphs overlapping a range of text in a Google Docs document, identified by its start and end character index.

operations.name: Delete Content Range
operations.description: Delete all content between a start and end character index in a Google Docs document. The endIndex is exclusive and must be greater than the startIndex.

operations.name: Create Named Range
operations.description: Create a named range over a span of content in a Google Docs document so it can be referenced or deleted later. The name may be 1-256 characters and need not be unique.

operations.name: Delete Named Range
operations.description: Delete one or more named ranges from a Google Docs document by their ID or by name. Provide exactly one of namedRangeId or name; deleting by name removes all ranges sharing that name. The content itself is not removed.
